A tennis ball travelling at a speed of $30 \text{ m s}^{-1}$ hits a racket elastically with a kinetic energy of $27 \text{ J}$.
The racket applies a variable force to the tennis ball for a time of $4.0 \text{ ms}$ as shown.
The ball moves away in the opposite direction to its initial motion.
With what speed does the ball leave the racket?
(Assume that resistive forces are negligible.)
